description: Create a server query in app/actions/<feature>/<name>.ts (defineQuery)
definition: A server function the client reads by name: useQuery('projects.list').

description: Create a server mutation in app/actions/<feature>/<name>.ts (defineMutation)
definition: A server function the client calls by name to change data: useMutation('projects.update').

description: Create a socket channel in app/channels
definition: A realtime channel: params, events with cache effects, and who may join.

description: Create a React component in app/components
definition: A reusable piece of UI with no route of its own.

description: Create a form component in app/components/forms
definition: A component that owns one schema-validated form and its submit.

description: Create a typed error class in app/exceptions
definition: A KitrError subclass with a code, turned into a typed error on every transport.

description: Create a React hook in app/hooks
definition: A use* function that packages React state or effects for reuse.

description: Create a pathless layout in app/layouts and add it to app/routes.ts
definition: A component that wraps a group of pages through <Outlet />; guards go on its route.

description: Create a page in app/pages and add it to app/routes.ts
definition: The component a route renders; the file path is the URL path.

description: Create a kitr provider in app/providers and list it in kitrrc.ts
definition: A lifecycle object: register container bindings, boot, and wrap the React tree.

description: Create the typed queries and mutations of one HTTP resource in app/queries
definition: Typed query and mutation contracts for an external HTTP API, one file per resource.

description: Create a Zustand store in app/stores
definition: Client-only state; server data belongs in queries, not here.

description: Create a shared zod schema in app/validators
definition: A zod schema and its type, shared by forms, actions and controllers.
A class whose methods answer routes; validation goes in static validation.

description: Create an API middleware in server/middleware
definition: A function that runs before and after a controller (auth, audit, rate limits).

description: Create a service class in server/services
definition: A plain class holding business logic, bound in the container by a provider.

description: Create a vitest file in test/
definition: An app-level Vitest file; unit tests may also sit beside their file as *.test.ts.
